definitions.total_households: Current realized household decision-unit mass; not resident persons.
definitions.dependent_child_households: At least one child in the active at-home/dependent proxy state m>=1; not literal under18 children.
definitions.no_dependent_child_households: Child-state m=0, including zero parity and empty-nest states.
definitions.zero_parity_households: Parity n=0; no previous successful modeled birth.
definitions.ever_parent_households: Parity n>=1; computed as total minus parity-zero mass.
definitions.empty_nest_households: Positive parity with zero active at-home child states n>=1,m=0; a model proxy, not empirical under18-empty-nest status.
definitions.young: Unchanged whole nodes26,30,34; not annual-age ACS alignment.
definitions.per100: All counts divided by common total2023 household mass and multiplied by100; no conversion to national household counts.

data_gaps: Saved group marginals do not contain the number of children within dependent-child households, counts with1/2/3+ children, or numbers of resident persons.
No age-specific child/person counts or pre-fertility group-specific stocks were extracted; exact transition-flow decomposition by first/later birth requires saved detailed states.
The first-birth category mechanism follows the pinned state transition, not a newly estimated demographic flow.
Empty-nest is a model-state label under its maintained child-maturation law, not a separately validated empirical classification.

The net return-to-dependent category is derived from the common-state impact partition; additional births among already-dependent households are the raw-birth residual. These are accounting differences, not a matched-individual switching decomposition.

impact_birth_accounting.scope: Net rebated2%-minus-rebated1% differences on the common2023 population; not identified individual switchers

maturation_caveat: Each child independently leaves the active at-home state with geometric probability4/18 per four-year step. Eighteen years is the expected duration, not a deterministic under18 cutoff; parameter-code definition independently inspected.

entry_handoff_and_baseline_trajectory.entry_flow_E_semantics: At every date this variable is the pre-fertility youngest age-node mass, sum(g_pre[...,age_index0,...]); from2027 onward that stock equals the cohort inserted at the previous date. The2023 cell comes from the empirical historical age bridge.
entry_handoff_and_baseline_trajectory.interpretation: Verified handoff between the empirical historical age profile and the inherited renewal queue; this accounting discontinuity is not by itself evidence of a coding error or policy-induced entry.
